title: From Ham-Sandwich to Centerpoints: Semialgebraic Algorithms for Cutting Polytopal Measures
summary: We design exact algorithms for the ham-sandwich and centerpoint theorems for polytopal measures. Our key observation is that the cap-volume function of such a measure, i.e., the volume cut off by a halfspace, is piecewise rational on a natural decomposition of the space of oriented hyperplanes. This lets us recast prescribed-proportion cutting problems as semialgebraic feasibility problems. For fixed ambient dimension, this yields polynomial-time algorithms to decide the existence of cuts, describe the full solution set, and sample or enumerate solutions.
